summary: Make asynchronous host submission and device completion visible before introducing overlapping work.
outcomes: Use events to express ordering and measure device work.
sequence: Separate the host call from the device operation.
Trace ordered operations in one stream.
Add a second stream and identify missing dependencies.
Insert events and waits at the necessary boundaries.
Compare default-stream modes and check overlap using a real trace.

visual.question: Can this consumer start before the data copy finishes?
visual.interaction: Move operations between streams and add event edges.
